Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_EMSG3_AdcCapture_Status_v1
Objects.description: EMSP G3 raw ADC capture state, and the DPTF receiver's verdict at the trigger

variables.name: state
variables.description: Capture state

variables.name: trigger
variables.description: Trigger the capture was armed with (Ctrl trigger option index)

variables.name: chMode
variables.description: Channel mode the capture was armed with (Ctrl chMode option index)

variables.name: channels
variables.description: Interleaved channels per sample: 1, or 4 in All mode

variables.name: flags
variables.description: packet_ok,packet_bad,saturated

variables.name: candidate
variables.description: Ranked candidate that decoded the trigger packet (0 = best peak)

variables.name: pageCount
variables.description: Pages in the frozen capture

variables.name: armId
variables.description: Ctrl armId this capture was armed by

variables.name: seq
variables.description: Capture number, new for every arm

variables.name: samples
variables.description: Samples per channel in the frozen capture

variables.name: fsHz
variables.description: ADC sample rate

variables.name: trigPos
variables.description: Sample index of the trigger in the capture

variables.name: peakPos
variables.description: Sample index of the DPTF guard start the receiver resolved to; negative if before the capture

variables.name: trigTimeMs
variables.description: Device uptime at the trigger

variables.name: metricQ8
variables.description: DPTF detection metric at the trigger, 1/256ths

variables.name: marginQ8
variables.description: Worst per-symbol slot ratio of the last decoded packet, 1/256ths

variables.name: noiseFloor
variables.description: DPTF chip magnitude noise floor at the trigger

variables.name: payload
variables.description: Decoded payload, when packet_ok

variables.name: chMin
variables.description: Smallest raw sample per receiver over the capture

variables.name: chMax
variables.description: Largest raw sample per receiver over the capture

variables.name: satCount
variables.description: Samples per receiver at full scale over the capture
